_note: Fill in can_id values after discovering signals with find_signal.py or SavvyCAN. Run decode.py once filled in.
_hint_rpm: Look for a 16-bit big-endian word that reads ~750 at idle and rises to ~6000. Often 0.25 rpm/bit.
_hint_throttle: Slow pedal sweep (scenario 7) isolates this cleanly. Usually a 1-byte 0–255 signal, scale ~0.392 for 0–100%.
_hint_speed: Steady cruise at known speed, compare to speedometer. Often 2 bytes, ~0.01 km/h per bit.
_hint_openDBC: Check github.com/commaai/opendbc for suzuki/ — K14C signals may already be named.
